Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Backend Software Engineer | Java / Kotlin

Lisbon, Portugal | daniel.okafor-reyes@example.com | +351 555 010 202 | linkedin.com/in/daniel-okafor-reyes-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 7 years of professional experience building and operating services in Java and Kotlin, with production experience in Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Kafka, Docker and AWS-based deployments. Skilled in query tuning, automated testing, CI/CD and production incident response. Python experience is limited to scripts and small Jenkins helpers; interested in moving into a backend role working primarily in Python.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Backend: Java (8–17), Kotlin (basic), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate; Python scripting (data fixes and small Jenkins helpers)
APIs and messaging: REST, OpenAPI, Kafka, RabbitMQ
Data: PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis
Cloud and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (EKS, S3, SQS), Jenkins, Git, Linux
Testing: JUnit 5, Testcontainers, Spring Cloud Contract

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Backend Engineer | Tejo Insurance Tech, Lisbon
Jan 2022–Present
- Develop and maintain 7 Java 17 / Spring Boot microservices for policy quoting and claims intake.
- Designed a versioned OpenAPI 3 REST API for broker quoting, including partner rate limiting and contract tests; the API serves 12 partners and around 400,000 quote requests per month.
- Improved quote endpoint p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 milliseconds by adding Redis caching and fixing JPA N+1 queries.
- Resolved duplicate claims from at-least-once Kafka delivery by implementing a transactional outbox and idempotent consumers; duplicate records fell from around 40 per week to zero over the following quarter.
- Deploy services using Helm to Kubernetes on EKS through Jenkins pipelines; use AWS S3 and SQS for service integrations. Participate in a one-week-per-month on-call rotation.
- Handled a significant Kafka lag incident in March 2024; the incident write-up was praised. Run the backend guild meeting every two weeks (since 2024).
- Built an internal Kotlin / Spring Boot service to render policy PDFs from templates and wrote the team's Kotlin coding guidelines.

Software Developer | Viajar Online S.A., Porto
Sep 2019–Dec 2021
- Built booking and payment features in a Java 11 / Spring MVC monolith backed by Oracle.
- Added integration tests with Testcontainers, raising payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70% and supporting safer refactoring.
- Extracted email and SMS notifications from the monolith into a Spring Boot service using RabbitMQ and Thymeleaf.

Junior Developer (Internship, then full-time) | CodeFarol Lda, Porto
Jul 2018–Aug 2019
- Maintained PHP and later Java applications for small business clients.

EDUCATION
BSc Informatics Engineering | Atlantic Polytechnic Institute, 2018

CERTIFICATION
Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 11 Developer, 2020

LANGUAGES
English (fluent; professional working language at Tejo Insurance Tech) | Portuguese (fluent) | Spanish (conversational)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, concise, professionally structured two-page CV with clear progression from junior developer to backend engineer. It uses quantified outcomes effectively, including API volume, latency reduction, test-coverage improvement, and the elimination of duplicate claims. The document is also commendably truthful about limited Python experience and does not overstate AWS, Terraform, or leadership experience. The summary is well tailored to the role by positioning Java/Kotlin as comparable backend experience and explicitly stating interest in moving primarily into Python. Minor opportunities remain to make English communication and technical trade-off explanation more explicit.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV is highly ATS-compatible: it uses conventional section headings, readable text, standard chronological structure, searchable technology names, and no problematic tables, graphics, columns, headers, or footers. It contains strong matches for Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, REST, OpenAPI, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, automated testing, Jenkins, CI/CD, and on-call production support. Its AI screening probability is high because the wording is specific, evidence-based, and transparent about Python proficiency. The main searchable omissions are explicit wording around safe schema migrations, GitHub Actions, Terraform, observability tooling, logistics/EDI, and Dutch or French; these should not be added because the original candidate information does not support them.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The candidate is a strong overall match. The comparable-language requirement is well supported through seven years of Java/Kotlin backend experience, Spring Boot production services, and an explicit interest in working primarily in Python. PostgreSQL, query tuning, REST API design, Docker, AWS deployment, automated testing, CI/CD, Kafka, Kubernetes, incident response, and production ownership align particularly well with the role. The CV also supports the company’s reliability and knowledge-sharing culture through on-call work, a praised incident write-up, the backend guild, and Kotlin coding guidelines. Gaps are limited to the candidate’s lack of demonstrated professional Python service development, no documented schema-migration experience, no Terraform authorship, no observability tooling, no logistics/transport or EDI experience, and no Dutch or French. These are job-alignment gaps rather than defects in the CV and should not be implied away.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT — In the LANGUAGES section, change "English (fluent; professional working language at Tejo Insurance Tech)" to "English (fluent; professional working language at Tejo Insurance Tech; writes incident reports and explains technical decisions clearly)" only if the candidate is comfortable making that direct statement. This makes the job’s English communication requirement and technical trade-off communication easier for ATS and recruiters to identify, while remaining supported by the candidate’s English-language work, praised incident write-up, and guild responsibilities.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT — In the Professional Summary, consider changing the final sentence from "interested in moving into a backend role working primarily in Python" to "seeking to apply seven years of Java/Kotlin backend experience while moving into a backend role working primarily in Python." This keeps the existing truthful disclosure of limited Python experience but makes the comparable-language fit and motivation more direct.
